source.title: Contact the Royal Canadian Mounted Police | Royal Canadian Mounted Police

notes: If you are in immediate danger or need urgent help, the RCMP says to call 9-1-1, your local RCMP detachment or the police service of jurisdiction in your area. MIRA has not yet confirmed 9-1-1 coverage in every territory (e.g. Nunavut). Source: https://www.rcmp.ca/en/contact-rcmp, retrieved 2026-09-26.
